item.title: Overgrown verges, 7th August
item.description:
Lakeview Road is lacking a bit of love and attention from the Gardening team. It's been mowed on one side of the road but some (green) banks, rose gardens and the spaces where houses are recessed from the road have been left overgrown, look unsightly and do not encourage residents to take pride in their street. A visit with a strimmer and some love for the roses would be wonderful please. On the plus side, the area of the former lake looks wonderful with many new trees added over the years. Great job!

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Lakeview Road, West Norwood, Greater London
